question: How should the worship of Kumbhā and Mīnā be carried out?
premises: Kumbhā and Mīnā are to be worshipped
The worship follows the previous method
The sequence begins from the tip
inference: One should worship Kumbhā and Mīnā as before, beginning from the tip, O Śāṅkarī
plain_english: O Śāṅkarī, one should worship Kumbhā and Mīnā as before, beginning from the tip.
